selection_rule: Highest measured same-mode GPQA accuracy among artifact-valid final-context-token -> answer-token-mean maps. Mapping R2, parameter count, estimated AA excluded. Freeze communicated to parent before subsequent candidate capability reads.

recommendation.status: Conditional map reuse: historical-main model revision inference requires exact-current-stack recapture parity; exact original generated token IDs missing; decisive new test must be content-disjoint.
recommendation.claim_scope: Highest observed point estimate in audited usable panel, not a statistically proven unique best open model.
recommendation.capability_uncertainty: Wilson intervals are descriptive iid-rollout binomial intervals. Five draws per shared GPQA question are clustered; do not use these intervals to assert unique model superiority.
